reviews.title: Works great no surprises.
reviews.comment: I replace a dying HDD drive on my Win10 computer that was running so slow my hair started to grow.  It works great I have a new usable computer.  No issues at all during installation and up to now.
reviews.author: Manuel

reviews.title: Laptop when from unusable to great instantly.
reviews.comment:
My ten year old HP laptop had the parking brake on half the time. Task Manager showed the Disk usage at 100% for long periods of time especially when starting on or even waking it up. I stopped using my laptop.
Cloning my hard drive to this SSD made my laptop work perfectly. Disk usage shows 3 to 5 percent now.
Don't forget to get a USB 3.0 to SATA 2.5" adapter for the cloning process,
reviews.author: Rod
